overview_description.description:
Batch.com is an SDK and marketing automation dashboard focused on marketing and transactional push notifications. It also includes mobile analytics which are useful to monitor and improve its users’ customer retention as well as engagement.

Batch.com helps marketers follow segmentation to improve mobile’s fundamental communication channels: push notifications and in-app messages. It supports iOS, Android, Windows, Unity, Adobe Air, and Cordova platforms.

Batch.com was launched in 2014 and is based in Paris, France.

about_short_description.short_description: Batch is the leading mobile CRM & push notifications platform

product.name: Customer Engagement Platform (CEP)
product.description: A platform that centralizes customer data and enables marketers to create, automate, and manage multi-channel CRM campaigns including Email, SMS, Mobile Push, Web Push, and In-App Messaging.

product.name: Mobile Push Notifications
product.description: A service to send targeted push notifications to mobile app users to engage and retain customers through personalized messaging.

product.name: In-App Messaging
product.description: A messaging service that delivers targeted messages to users within a mobile app, triggered by user actions or app events.

product.name: Web Push Notifications
product.description: A service to send push notifications to users on desktop and mobile web browsers to engage prospects and customers without requiring email addresses.

product.name: Email Campaigns
product.description: A module for creating, sending, and managing email marketing campaigns with personalization and deliverability features.

product.name: SMS Messaging
product.description: A service for sending SMS messages to customers for marketing and transactional communication across supported countries.
